title.en: AN ACT MAKING THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND SIXTEEN, AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF PRISONERS FROM THE PROVINCIAL JAIL OF RIZAL TO BILIBID PRISON, APPLICABLE TO THE PROVINCE OF CAVITE.
title.orig: AN ACT MAKING THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND SIXTEEN, AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF PRISONERS FROM THE PROVINCIAL JAIL OF RIZAL TO BILIBID PRISON, APPLICABLE TO THE PROVINCE OF CAVITE.
title.vi: Đạo luật áp dụng các quy định của Đạo luật số 516 cho tỉnh Cavite
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้บทบัญญัติของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 516 ซึ่งอนุญาตให้ย้ายนักโทษจากเรือนจำจังหวัดริซัลไปยังเรือนจำบิลิบิด มีผลใช้บังคับกับจังหวัดกาบิตี
title.id: Undang-Undang Menerapkan Ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor 516 ke Provinsi Cavite

text.en:
The provisions of Act Numbered Five hundred and sixteen, entitled "An Act authorizing the
removal of prisoners from the provincial jail of Rizal to Bilibid Prison on account of the unhealthfulness and
insecurity of the provincial jail of Rizal," are hereby made applicable to the Province of Cavite, and the
prisoners detained in the jail of the Province of Cavite may be removed to Bilibid Prison, and thence
withdrawn in accordance with the provisions and conditions of said Act Numbered Five hundred and sixteen.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 24, 1903.
